title: Contractor Dispatch on Rental Property Service Requests
content:
**Dispatch standard for Rental Property Service Contracts.**

1. A contractor is dispatched only on a service request whose contract status is active, as the contract's system record shows.
2. The request goes to a network contractor whose trade matches and whose service ZIP codes include the property ZIP code, preferred before standard, never suspended, and emergency-capable for an emergency; ties go to the contractor reference that sorts first alphabetically.
3. The contractor arranges access with the requester (the authorized tenant when the tenant placed the request) within the tier's routine contact window in hours, or the emergency contact window for an emergency; a missed window leads to re-dispatch with the reason recorded as a re-dispatch for missed contact.
4. A second opinion goes to a different eligible contractor, and a recall to the original contractor unless now suspended.
5. Each assignment carries the next dispatch sequence number, starting at 1.

## Selection order (point 2)

| Order | Test |
|---|---|
| Eligibility | trade matches; property ZIP code within the contractor's service ZIP codes; not suspended; emergency-capable when the request is an emergency |
| First preference | preferred contractors before standard contractors |
| Tie-break | the contractor reference that sorts first alphabetically |

*Hypothetical:* two eligible preferred plumbers with references "C-104" and "C-087" serve the property ZIP code; the request goes to "C-087". A first assignment carries sequence 1; a re-dispatch after a missed contact window carries sequence 2.
